brief: An intuitive platform that extracts high-virality hooks from long-form video. The visual identity had to feel elegant, soft, and technical using #ffd700 and #FFFFFF without cliché scissors or film brackets.
criteria: Success: Distinct abstract mark, scales cleanly down to 16 px, zero cliché scissors/brackets, radiant in dark and light interfaces.

concepts.name: Sol Aperture
concepts.idea: A rotational dual-crescent iris capturing the distilled golden moment at its center.
rationale: 180° rotational symmetry with dynamic 45° diagonal breathing space
Central golden core symbolizes the isolated viral hook and harmonizes with the typography
Pure circular arc geometry with 100% rounded caps delivers technical precision and approachable softness

recommendation: Sol Aperture establishes a distinctive, premium SaaS presence that remains ultra-crisp at every scale from 16 px dock icons to full UI headers.
next_steps: Direction B approved for production deployment
Master vector assets and full icon suite exported
Integrate favicon and app icons into frontend/public/
